method: Image-tool style and contrast edits, followed by deterministic sprite-grid export.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer plus small object-size edit.
IMAGE 1 is COLOSSUS, the character identity and pose to keep. IMAGE 2 is our actual PROTAGONIST SPRITE and is the STRICT STYLE / PIXEL-DENSITY authority. Redraw Colossus as an actual low-resolution game sprite that belongs beside image2. The previous Colossus was far too detailed. This must be a substantial simplification, NOT the same detailed illustration with a pixel filter.

PIXEL SYSTEM:
Imagine a 96 x 176 logical pixel canvas, enlarged 8x to 768 x 1408. Each art pixel is ONE flat 8x8 square on one consistent grid. The figure stands about 156 logical pixels tall (head y12, feet y168), compared with the player's 111-pixel standing height. Colossus is physically about 40% taller, but BOTH characters use the SAME size art pixels on screen. Do not give Colossus finer pixels. No fine outlines smaller than one grid pixel, no anti-aliasing, no subpixel shading, no blur.
Match image2's chunky angular clusters, simple face, hard 1-pixel outline, flat cel shading and economical detail. Face roughly 14–17 art pixels wide, features as a few deliberate blocks; no individually drawn beard hairs, pores, veins, stippling or realistic fabric texture. Large muscles described with 3–4 clean shade masses, trousers with only a few broad angular folds. Hair/stubble read as one dark mass with one grey highlight band. Skin maximum 4 shades; suit maximum 5; metal 3; leather 3. Palette muted, upper-right light.
Use dark navy outline #101118; cloth ramp #1B1D27 #282B36 #373B49 #4D5365 #697287; muted skin #EAB58D #D69B75 #B77F63 #8D6050; pale chalk/highlight #E4E9F4; small blue signals #6FA9DC; worn brown belt #51332A #79503A #A6744B. No gradients.

KEEP CHARACTER:
Exact recognizable Colossus from image1: huge tall muscular human man, receding short dark/grey hair, short stubble, weathered calm exhausted face, three-quarter facing SCREEN-LEFT. Same proportions and relaxed stance; torso/arms massive without turning him into a monster. Same dark sleeveless gym tank, loose dark pants, plain grey shoes; chalked hands. Same small neck implant with short cable disappearing UNDER the shirt collar; separate round shoulder connector; forearm inset plates and thin wires; small wrist tracker on SCREEN-RIGHT wrist. Simplify these into readable 1–3-pixel marks. The leather weight belt and draped steel chain remain, with a few bold linked shapes. Subtle Colossus Gym/barbell motif: simplify to a small faded emblem, never tiny detailed lettering that requires finer pixels.

PLATE:
Increase the 100 KG plate diameter by 20% relative to image1 at the same body height. Target visible full vertical plate diameter about 38 logical pixels in this 156-pixel-tall figure, rather than about32. Right hand (SCREEN-LEFT, no tracker) grips the UPPER OUTER RIM effortlessly, arm hanging down. Plate stays BEHIND his right trouser leg: trousers visibly overlap and hide the inner/right 35–45% of the disc. Do not draw the disc in front of the leg. Keep a thick rim and small center hole, simple dark iron shades, NO speckled rust texture. A tiny simplified "100" or "100 KG" mark if it fits the pixel grid, not high-resolution text. Do not enlarge the hand or change his pose.

OUTPUT:
One complete standalone low-resolution pixel sprite, same left-facing character and pose. Genuine transparent PNG background with no halo, shadow, scenery, checkerboard pixels, captions, guides, extra characters or panels. Full head, shoes and plate fit within the cell. Pixel simplicity must match image2 throughout.

Use case: precise-object-edit / lighting adjustment. Edit IMAGE1, our normalized low-resolution Colossus GAME SPRITE. Image2 is the protagonist style reference. KEEP the coarse square-pixel grid and exactly the same logical density as image1; never add finer pixels.

Requested final change: deepen the palette and push local contrast, especially his weathered face. Keep the light side warm and restrained, but add deeper brown-purple shadows under the brow, in the eye socket, beside the nose, under cheekbones and beard/jaw. Add only 1–2 short deliberate dark pixel-cluster wrinkles at forehead/brow so he feels older and tired, not angry. Keep his eyes human, heavy and calm. Use clearer dark shapes rather than fine stippling or extra tiny lines.
Skin 4–5 tones: restrained light #DDB087, mid #C18B66, shade #96664F, deep #67473E, darkest crease #41333A. Keep highlights small; do not brighten his whole body.
Cloth: push fold troughs and armpit shadows to deep navy #101522 while retaining broad existing grey-navy highlight planes. No grey/white haze. Chalk, chain and tracker remain small readable highlights.

Preserve identity, enormous proportions, 156-art-pixel standing height, left-facing pose, loose pants, tank's simple barbell gym emblem, cybernetic forearm/neck mods, short cable entering UNDER collar, wrist tracker, weight-belt chain, relaxed right-hand rim grip and feet.
The plate stays BEHIND his anatomical right trouser leg (screen-left), with the pants occluding its inner portion. Carry forward the requested 20% diameter increase relative to v4: make its total visible vertical extent about 38 logical pixels, from the grip at roughly y98 to its bottom near y136 in this 96x176 cell. Current plate is slightly undersized; enlarge only the plate downward/outward from the fixed upper-rim grip, keep the leg in front, and do not change arm or pose. Plate mark is a compact 100, simplified for this resolution.

CRITICAL OUTPUT: same 96x176 logical pixel canvas enlarged as perfectly flat 8x8 blocks. Keep simple clusters, limited palette, no smoothing, no anti-aliasing, no gradients or fine texture. Full isolated sprite on genuine transparent background. No scenery, shadow, glow or vignette. Do not alter canvas, silhouette or framing except the small plate increase. This is the final tonal polish of a coarse game sprite, not a detailed character illustration.

Use case: precise-object-edit / lighting adjustment. IMAGE1 is the existing Colossus close-up portrait to edit. IMAGE2 is the newly darkened game sprite and is a PALETTE/CONTRAST reference, not a pose or framing reference.
Make only a tonal refinement to image1: slightly darker overall midtones, deeper face shadows and more readable weathered wrinkles. Increase local contrast under the brow, under the lower eyelids, in forehead creases, beside the nose, through cheek hollows, at the mouth corners and underneath the jaw/stubble. Use deliberate dark brown-purple pixel clusters, not thin scribbles, noise or smoothed shading. He must remain calm, exhausted and human; do NOT turn the expression into a scowl, sneer or threat.
Skin ramp: muted light #DDB087, mid #C18B66, shadow #96664F, deep #67473E, creases #41333A. Retain restrained warm upper-right highlights, avoiding an orange or pale washed-out face. Tank/navy shadows become slightly deeper, with readable folds; do not brighten the backdrop. Grey hair and stubble remain visibly salt-and-pepper.

Preserve exactly the same character, left-facing gaze, head/shoulder proportions, receding hair, beard, square jaw, tank, worn COLOSSUS GYM/barbell print, neck implant and thin wires disappearing under collar, separate round shoulder disc, gym plates/chains behind him, square framing and transparent pixel-dithered outer silhouette. Portrait detail can be greater than the tiny full-body sprite, but remain clean low-resolution pixel art, like a 128x128 logical portrait enlarged with hard square edges. No anti-aliasing, blur, smooth gradients or tiny rendered skin texture.
Output the SAME matching portrait on transparent outer background. No scene expansion, extra people, captions or UI.
